statement_en: Let $A$ be a Lebesgue measurable subset of $\mathbb{R}^n$. Then for almost every point, $$d_A(x)=1_A(x)\text{ for a.e. }x\in \mathbb{R}^n$$ In general, if a point $x$ satisfies $d_A(x)=1$, then it is called a density point of $A$.
callout_body:
集合$A$是$\mathbb{R}^n$当中Lebesgue可测的子集，那么对于几乎所有点而言$$d_A(x)=1_A(x)\text{ for a.e. }x\in \mathbb{R}^n$$

一般来说如果一个点$x$对应的$d_A(x)=1$那么我们一般称其为"集合A的密度点"或者说a point of density for A。
